description:
• Brand introduction:

We are Natural Movement 4 the People, a company that believes in harnessing the power of nature to provide gentle and organic products that promote happiness, health, and well-being for families. Our slogan, "Natural solutions to cultivate happiness, health, and take care of our families," embodies our commitment to offering products that prioritize the health and safety of our customers. "Nature's Oils" is our first and only product line at the moment, offering various natural oil-based products like mouthwash and hair and body oil. 


• Product description: 

a. Nature's Oils Family Mouthwash: An oil-based mouthwash made from a blend of coconut oil and olive oil, designed for oil pulling practice. Oil pulling with these natural ingredients offers numerous benefits for dental health. This mouthwash is suitable for all family members. 

b. Nature's Oils Pregnancy Mouthwash: A specially formulated oil-based mouthwash, combining coconut oil and olive oil, designed for pregnant women's dental health. Oil pulling during pregnancy with our mouthwash can have positive effects on both the mother's and the baby's health. 

c. Nature's Oils Hair and Body Oil: This versatile product combines various natural oils such as coconut oil, olive oil, argan oil, tea tree oil, orange oil, lemon oil, organic lavender oil, sandalwood, grapeseed oil, castor oil, and rosemary oil. It offers remarkable benefits for both hair and skin and is safe for babies and all family members.

• USP (Unique Selling Point):

100% pure and organic oils from nature providing a healthier and more sustainable option for individuals and families worldwide.
